## Q1 — Every cloud model/provider dependency

### Gemini embeddings (the only embedding provider)
`src/lib/embedding.ts` — the sole embedding implementation:
- `embedding.ts:28` `const DEFAULT_MODEL = "gemini-embedding-2-preview"` (multimodal: text/image/video/audio/PDF).
- `embedding.ts:29` `const DEFAULT_DIMS = 768` (Matryoshka truncation, L2-normalized when `< 3072`; native is 3072 — `embedding.ts:182,258`).
- Task types enum `embedding.ts:18-26`: `RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT` (default, `:137,210`), `RETRIEVAL_QUERY`, `SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY`, `CLASSIFICATION`, `CLUSTERING`, `QUESTION_ANSWERING`, `FACT_VERIFICATION`, `CODE_RETRIEVAL_QUERY`.
- Two encodings handled: v2 preview models embed the task as a **text prefix** (`applyV2TaskPrefix`, `embedding.ts:51-72`, `usesV2TaskPrefix` `:36-38`); legacy `gemini-embedding-001` uses the `taskType` **field** (`:152-154`, `:226-228`).
- Endpoints: `:142` `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${model}:embedContent` and batch `:215` `...:batchEmbedContents`.
- Keys read: `GEMINI_API_KEY ?? GOOGLE_API_KEY` (`embedding.ts:94, 118, 133, 206`); also lazily loaded from `~/.rlmx/settings.json` `:118-131`.

### rlmx (the reasoning/agent engine) — default provider/model
- Dependency `@automagik/rlmx@0.260528.2` (`package.json:52`). Also `@mariozechner/pi-ai` / `@mariozechner/pi-agent` (the underlying LLM client, "pi-ai").
- rlmx-brain config generator hardcodes provider/model: `src/lib/rlmx-config.ts:53-55` → `provider: google`, `model: gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview`.
